Create one anndata obj with neuronal clusters and non-neuronal broadclasses
```{r setup}
library(BPCells)
library(tidyverse)
library(sccomp)
library(readxl)
library(reticulate)
library(SingleCellExperiment)
library(singleCellTK)
use_python("/opt/miniconda3/bin/python")
#load ge matrix
ge_mat = open_matrix_dir("../post_qc_decontx_counts/")
neuronal_cluster_assignments = readRDS("../neuronal_number_ids_cluster_assignments.rds")
non_neuronal_cluster_assignments = readRDS("../non_neuronal_assignments.rds")

#append neuronal to non neuronal
cluster_assignments = c(non_neuronal_cluster_assignments, neuronal_cluster_assignments)

```

Generate cell metadata from animal-level metadata, animal-level characteristics, and cluster assignments. Perform testing and evaluation on each cell class separately.
```{r}
#clean animal metadata
animal_metadata = readr::read_csv("../mouse_meta.csv")
animal_metadata$ID = as.character(animal_metadata$ID)
animal_metadata = animal_metadata %>% dplyr::select("ID", "Sex", "Line.short", "Genotype", "Age (months)") %>% dplyr::rename("age" = "Age (months)","strain" = "Line.short", "sex" = "Sex", "genotype" = "Genotype", "animal_id" = "ID")
#load animal phenotype data
animal_phenotype_data = read.csv("../YM_CFC_BW_SM_calo_AB_individual_data_cleaned_20240826.csv")
animal_phenotype_data_ge_mice = animal_phenotype_data %>% filter(ID %in% animal_metadata$animal_id)
#add age of death, then filter behavioral metadata for this timepoint, since some mice were phenotyped more than just prior to death. But our analysis will focus on the data collected from the timepoint prior to death. 

animal_phenotype_data_ge_mice$age_at_death = animal_metadata$age[match(animal_phenotype_data_ge_mice$ID, animal_metadata$animal_id)]
animal_phenotype_data_at_death = animal_phenotype_data_ge_mice %>% filter(age_at_death == AgeGrp)


#add CFA and CFM (cognitive metrics) for each mouse
animal_metadata$CFA = animal_phenotype_data_at_death$CFC.PS4[match(animal_metadata$animal_id, animal_phenotype_data_at_death$ID)]
animal_metadata$CFM = animal_phenotype_data_at_death$CFM.Total[match(animal_metadata$animal_id, animal_phenotype_data_at_death$ID)]


#add Weight (metabolic/physical metrics) for each mouse
animal_metadata$Weight = animal_phenotype_data_at_death$Weight[match(animal_metadata$animal_id, animal_phenotype_data_at_death$ID)]
#z score continuous variables (Weight, CFA, CFM)
animal_metadata <- animal_metadata %>%
  mutate(across(c(Weight, CFA, CFM), ~ scale(.x, center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)[, 1]))

#change age_at_death to "young" for 6 and "old" for 14
animal_metadata$age = case_when(
  animal_metadata$age == "6" ~ "young",
  animal_metadata$age == "14" ~ "old",
  .default = NA
)

animal_metadata$age = factor(animal_metadata$age, levels = c("young","old"))
#create df with cell id and cluster for each cell
cell_metadata = data.frame(cell_id = names(cluster_assignments), cluster = cluster_assignments)
df_internal_and_official_name = read_csv("../internal_to_official_name_conversions_neuronal.csv")
cell_metadata = cell_metadata %>% mutate(cluster = case_when(
  cluster %in% df_internal_and_official_name$numeric_id ~ df_internal_and_official_name$official_name[match(cluster, df_internal_and_official_name$numeric_id)],
  .default = cluster
))
cell_metadata$cluster = as.factor(cell_metadata$cluster)

#get animal id from name of cell ()
cell_metadata$animal_id = gsub(".*_(\\d+)-.*", "\\1", cell_metadata$cell_id)
#join cell metadata with animal metadata by animal_id
cell_metadata = cell_metadata %>% left_join(animal_metadata, by = "animal_id")

#Remove the single animal w/o CFC/CFA measurements (could be potential confound)
animal_wo_cfa_or_cfm = animal_metadata %>% filter(is.na(CFM) | is.na(CFA)) %>% pull(animal_id) %>% unique %>% as.character
animal_metadata = animal_metadata %>% filter(!animal_id %in% animal_wo_cfa_or_cfm)
cell_metadata = cell_metadata %>% filter(!animal_id %in% animal_wo_cfa_or_cfm)
# add cell class
cell_metadata =cell_metadata %>% mutate(cell_class = case_when(
  cluster %in% df_internal_and_official_name$official_name ~ "neuronal",#neuronal
  .default = sub("[-_].*", "", cluster) #non-neuronal
)) 
cell_metadata$cell_class = as.factor(cell_metadata$cell_class)
#Identify classes with only one cluster and remove from proportion analysis, since we do it by class - removed tcells, bam
#add "animal_" to animal_id column to avoid problems with sccomp, and convert to factor; and do same for animal_metadata
cell_metadata$animal_id = paste0("animal_",cell_metadata$animal_id) %>% as.factor() 

#if cluster is not neuronal, set cluster to broad class; except for vascular, in which case do smc, endothelial, pericytes separately; and astrocytes- split "GLS" and "non-GLS"
cell_metadata = cell_metadata %>% mutate(cluster = case_when(
  cell_class == "neuronal" ~ cluster,
  grepl("^vascular-endothelial", cluster) ~ "vascular-endothelial",
  grepl("^vascular-pericyte", cluster) ~ "vascular-pericytes",
  grepl("^vascular-smc", cluster) ~ "vascular-smc",
  cluster == "astrocyte-3" ~ "GLS-astrocytes",
  .default = cell_class)
)
cell_metadata = cell_metadata %>% droplevels()
```


Write anndata objects for all cells together
```{r}
#Check no duplicated cell ids
try(if(!length(cell_metadata$cell_id %>% duplicated() %>% which()) == 0) stop("duplicated ids"))

cell_metadata$sex = factor(cell_metadata$sex, levels = c("Male","Female"))
cell_metadata$genotype = factor(cell_metadata$genotype, levels = c("Ntg","5XFAD"))
cell_metadata$strain = factor(cell_metadata$strain)
cell_metadata$strain = cell_metadata$strain %>% relevel(ref = "B6")

#reparametrize so age*genotype combinations are in separate groups
cell_metadata = cell_metadata %>%
  mutate(age_genotype = interaction(age, genotype,sep = "_"))
#levels: young_Ntg old_5XFAD young_5XFAD old_Ntg
```


```{r}
genes_to_remove <- rownames(ge_mat)[grepl("^Gm|Rik", rownames(ge_mat))]
ge_mat = ge_mat[!rownames(ge_mat) %in% genes_to_remove, ]

# Get counts 
all_counts = ge_mat[,cell_metadata$cell_id] 

# Prepare metadata 
rownames(cell_metadata) <- cell_metadata$cell_id

# Prepare var metadata 
var_metadata <- data.frame(gene = rownames(all_counts))
rownames(var_metadata) <- var_metadata$gene
```


```{r}
library(anndata)

# Create anndata object
anndata_obj <- anndata::AnnData(
  X = NULL, 
  obs = cell_metadata, 
  var = var_metadata, 
  shape = c(ncol(all_counts), nrow(all_counts))
)


# Write anndata to h5ad
anndata::write_h5ad(anndata = anndata_obj, filename = "./dreamlet-anndata.h5ad")
BPCells::write_matrix_anndata_hdf5(mat = all_counts, path = "./dreamlet-anndata.h5ad", group = "X", gzip_level = 9)
```
